A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 5 May 2013. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:CC-D-chiefretwin-PC-Errata-2013-disc-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Chief Retwin (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): Same words as the previous version. This is a full card image again, with the printed art, title and lore (350 × 490 pixels); a small round bronze disc at the lower right marks it as errata.

The 2013 slip and the same area of the 2013 disc card, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
